translations.web: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?
translations.bsb: Are you not aware that I can call on My Father, and He will at once put at My disposal more than twelve legions of angels?
translations.kjv: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?
translations.asv: Or thinkest thou that I cannot beseech my Father, and he shall even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?
